newsitem.title: FRANCE: Publicis wins Tefal ad budget.
newsitem.headline: Publicis wins Tefal ad budget.

text.p: French advertising agency Publicis Conseil said on Thursday it had won kitchen utensil maker Tefal's worldwide advertising budget in competition with other agencies.
It said in a statement that it won the tender in competition with Ogilvy & Mather and BDDP.
Tefal, which makes non-stick saucepans and frying pans, previously charged Ogilvy & Mather with its French budget while internationally it was a client of Maclaren Lintas.
A Publicis spokeswoman could not immediately give the amount of the Tefal worldwide budget.
She said Publicis already handles advertising for domestic appliance maker Rowenta, another subsidiary of Tefal's parent, SEB. No one was immediately available at SEB to comment.
